evidence.note: Early on, stands up vinext dev manually and curls specific routes (/, /about, /api/hello, /old-about redirect) to verify SSR, routing, API and redirects beyond 'it compiles'.

Parses playwright-env-results.json with python to extract pass/fail, root-causes the mass failure to console-errors-during-hydration, and studies the test harness (swap_to_solution, vite.config injection) to understand how verification actually runs.

Runs a targeted single playwright test (hydration.spec) against a manually-started dev server on the real test port, uses the 2-pass/1-fail result to identify the __NEXT_DATA__ gap, then runs the pages-router subset.

Isolates specific failing subsystem (search page), starts server, curls the route, reads /tmp/app.log, root-causes missing next/form shim, fixes; iterates build->full-suite->inspect-failures loop with rising pass counts (31->160->176).
Subsystem-specific verification for ISR cache headers and OPTIONS/Allow: reads the exact fixture and spec, curls the specific route (search-query?multi) to confirm behavior before/after fix.
Consistently confirms the production build path (node scripts/build.mjs) and copies dist before curl/test, verifying both dev and built output rather than only dev.
Continues build+full-suite regression gating to ~302/325; full suite used as regression gate throughout, but late-game iteration leans on grepping RESULTS rather than adding new layered probes.

reasoning: The agent designed a real verification loop: fast curl probes against manually stood-up fixture apps to observe SSR/middleware/ISR/action behavior, root-cause interpretation of failures via parsed results.json and log inspection, and the full Playwright suite used repeatedly as a regression gate while confirming both dev and production build paths — squarely the level-8 anchor. It stops short of 10 because targeted checks are predominantly curl rather than minimal reproductions for the hardest subsystems (RSC), and it inspects the visible suite's specific failures rather than deliberately probing behaviors the suite may under-cover.
